description: Source code implementing trigonometric functions (sin, cos, tan) for rational numbers, including angle conversions and Taylor series approximations.

methods.name: scalerat
methods.description: Converts angle to a standard range based on angle type (radians, degrees, gradians).

methods.name: _sinrat
methods.description: Calculates sine of a rational number using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: sinrat
methods.description: Prepares and calls _sinrat to compute sine of a rational number.

methods.name: sinanglerat
methods.description: Calculates sine of an angle given in various units (degrees, gradians) and converts to radians before computing.

methods.name: _cosrat
methods.description: Calculates cosine of a rational number using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: cosrat
methods.description: Prepares and calls _cosrat to compute cosine of a rational number.

methods.name: cosanglerat
methods.description: Calculates cosine of an angle given in degrees or gradians.

methods.name: _tanrat
methods.description: Calculates tangent of a rational number by dividing sine by cosine.

methods.name: tanrat
methods.description: Prepares and calls _tanrat to compute tangent of a rational number.

methods.name: tananglerat
methods.description: Calculates tangent of an angle in degrees or gradians.
